**Fixed cold-review candidate integrity: engram setup() root-honoring, symlink hash by target, refusal names paths, claude backend disables hooks**

Two independent defects made the claude-engine cold-review stage refuse or crash on its own candidate: (1) engram.setup() discarded the BRAIN_MEMORY_TEST_ROOT root its caller forwarded, so cli.backend-fallback.test.mjs's own real-subprocess setup test wrote .engram -> .memory into the real repo root on every npm test run — measured with strace, reproduced in isolation; (2) candidate-snapshot.mjs hashed a symlink with readFileSync, which follows the link and threw EISDIR on a symlink to a directory. Fixed both at the seam: engram.setup({root}) now forwards to ensureMemorySymlink(root); candidate-snapshot.mjs now hashes readlinkSync(path) (the link's target string), never the resolved target. Also: the candidate-changed refusal now names the changed paths (bounded to 10 + count) instead of only saying something changed, and the claude harness backend now always spawns with --settings {disableAllHooks:true} so this repo's own SessionStart hook never runs inside a stage it is asked to review. Strict TDD: RED test first for every unit, GREEN after the fix, one mutation per unit confirmed red. Full suite: 5590/5590 green, .engram confirmed absent from the real repo root before and after the run.
